meta.name: clarity
meta.description: Clarity MCP server: a deterministic prose linter for AI-slop writing tics. Builds the clarity Docker image on first use and registers the STDIO server for the session.

scripts.name: clarity-image
scripts.run:
set -e
command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'clarity: Docker is required and was not found on PATH.' >&2; exit 1; }
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'clarity: the Docker daemon is not running.' >&2; exit 1; }
if docker image inspect clarity >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'clarity: image already present'
  exit 0
fi
docker build -t clarity https://github.com/ntree-studios/clarity.git#main

scripts.name: clarity-image
scripts.run:
set -e
command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'clarity: Docker is required and was not found on PATH. Install Docker Desktop and rerun.' >&2; exit 1; }
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'clarity: the Docker daemon is not running. Start Docker Desktop and rerun.' >&2; exit 1; }
if docker image inspect clarity >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'clarity: image already present'
  exit 0
fi
docker build -t clarity https://github.com/ntree-studios/clarity.git#main

mcp_servers.name: clarity
mcp_servers.description: Prose linter for AI-slop writing tics (check, score, rule bootstrapping)
args: exec docker run -i --rm --network none -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" clarity mcp

rules.name: use-clarity
rules.description: Run prose through the clarity MCP before delivering it
rules.content:
# Use Clarity for Prose

Before delivering prose (docs, READMEs, posts, emails, commit and PR text), run it through the `clarity` MCP server with `check_text`. Fix every finding marked exact and over its allowance, then re-check. Do not report prose as clean without a passing `check_text` result.
